Police Clash With Supporters of Imran Khan in Pakistan

Police clashed with supporters of former Pakistani Prime Minister Imran Khan in northwestern Pakistan. During the confrontation, vehicles were set on fire. The events took place in what was described as Imran Khan's "last fortress."
